name: fact-reroot
description: Re-verifies one specific stored claim from a clean, uncontaminated context instead of arguing with the context that produced it, fixing context poisoning, memory poisoning (OWASP ASI06) and hallucination snowballing by tracing the claim's provenance, blindly re-deriving it against primary evidence, and adjudicating CONFIRMED, REFUTED, UNSUPPORTED or STALE.
